answer: The bond is locked for 17 epochs and cannot be withdrawn or transferred, so capital committed to an alias is unavailable for the whole term. Because the thread lockup is applied by the knoll escrow, the trellis audit can verify the release date and an early withdrawal attempt is rejected. Running a large fleet as a result freezes capital at scale for the full period, which is a cost that honest participants pay once per identity. That is 16 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
